label: phase22 backend-capability assertions
note: Baseline probe run to determine gate status for P1 (vectorizer#306) and P2 (nexus#3/#4) before proceeding with gated phases.

gate_vectorizer_306.reason: Vectorizer 3.4.0-fastembed serves fastembed:all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (a dense embedding model at dim=384). The /embed endpoint returns real dense vectors, not BM25/keyword fallback. The BM25-coercion bug (vectorizer#306) is not present in 3.4.0-fastembed.
gate_vectorizer_306.dim_note: Deployed dim is 384 (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), not 768 as the proposal anticipated. CORTEX_EMBEDDER_DIM=384 in .env. Phase22 §2.2 must flip to 384, not 768.

match_param_probe.note: nexus#3 (RETURN $param) confirmed working — inline-literal workarounds can be removed once P2 begins

property_less_nodes.note: These nodes have only the internal _nexus_id — no Cortex properties (id, kind, repo, etc.). This is consistent with the nexus#4 property-loss class: MERGE ran but SET was not persisted for a subset of writes.

no_id_nodes.note: Nodes where n.id IS NULL — superset of property-less nodes; includes edge-of-graph connectors and partially-written nodes.

gate_nexus_3.reason: Nexus 2.3.4 correctly binds $x in RETURN $x AS val. Param binding is functional. Inline-literal Cypher workarounds introduced for nexus#3 can be removed in P2 §3.3-§3.5.

gate_nexus_4.reason: 4789/37067 nodes (12.9%) in the live graph are property-less (only _nexus_id). These are legacy nodes written under the buggy write path. A fresh-write verification (MERGE → read-back, confirmed property persistence) is required in P2 §3.3 before declaring the corruption class resolved. The existing straggler cohort may need a re-seed to clear.

P1_dense_lane.action: Proceed to P1 (§2.1-§2.5): re-index corpus at dim 384, assert dense hits, measure MRR

P2_graph_workaround_removal.blocker: nexus#4 straggler cohort (4789 property-less nodes) needs fresh-write round-trip verification in §3.3 before claiming the corruption class is resolved
P2_graph_workaround_removal.action: Proceed to §3.2 (param-binding smoke IT), then §3.3 (write→read IT) to confirm nexus#4 status before removing workarounds
